question: Where can I find a park in the north direction of Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism, Hutto, TX, limited to 190 kilometers?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks WHERE ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hutto%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 190000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ST_Centroid( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hutto%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ) ), ST_Centroid(geometry) ) ) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 OR degrees( ST_Azimuth( ST_Centroid( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hutto%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ) ), ST_Centroid(geometry) ) ) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5;
